headline: Oil prices decline on hopes for resolution to Iran conflict
summary: Oil prices extended losses as market participants reacted to increased optimism regarding a potential end to the conflict involving Iran.
why: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are a major factor in global energy supply security and oil price volatility.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Reduced geopolitical risk in oil-producing regions typically lowers the risk premium on oil prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The prospect of a de-escalation in the Iran conflict reduces fears of supply disruptions in the Middle East.
